featured_reviews.name: Prathmesh kushwaha
featured_reviews.review_text:
It was Biggest Mistake of life that I could agreed to get married at this marriage Hall.
(यहां शादी करने का निर्णय मेरे जीवन का सबसे गलत निर्णय था)

I'll recommend All Hindus not to choose this hall for your occasion just to save some Money.
(मैं सभी हिंदू परिवार से निवेदन करता हु 🙏🏼 की वो कुछ पैसे बचने के लिए इस हॉल को पसंद ना करें )

It was the Muslim community Hall (catering & staff ) They almost argue in all wedding and spoil wedding Rituals. 😤 😩 😧

Mine was Overnight wedding so we paid the charges accordingly. Still after 11 PM, they started arguing about the staff timing, stopped our photo session to made Mandap In front of Stage. ( We had previously asked to shift mandap somewhere else but as per them Mandap Can't be moved as per the hall Heights. Ch*t*as feel like we dont know the engineering🤷‍♂️ . I have Shared the pictures. Hall & Beam Height is symmetrical throughout and Mandap Can be Build anywhere you want. So it shows staff is not cooperative.)

They charge for Hall Rent and Decoration. Also Additional for Night wedding. We couldn't understand, Why they were worried about the delaying of staff timing after 11 PM ? as we pays additional for those staff Only. 🤔

We had ordered 500 plates all together but without the intimation of additional plate on the counter they charged us for the additional 60 i.e. 560 plate while finalising the Hall Bills. So It's an another Fraud from the staff. 🤨😑

Stage is not suitable as per the height, No proper Air conditioning at the center. Unnecessary sofas on the stage. No proper lighting on face for couple which in turn spoils the photography.

Behaviour of the manager & Staff is almost pathetic. We couldn't take the Family picture in my marriage and now it is unforgettable memory of my life. 😢

Do not get attracted by the first look. Initially they are polite, Humble & supportive but after whole payment (as per rule before 15 days) They becomes the business person or like political leader. if you choose this hall, you are ready to spoil your wedding.

Decision is yours...👍

featured_reviews.name: Farhan Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently hosted our engagement ceremony at Flags Banquet in Andheri, and the entire experience was flawless. This venue is the pinnacle of professionalism, offering comprehensive services that ensured our special day was stress-free and spectacular.
The staff and management were incredibly professional and detail-oriented from start to finish. A major highlight was the level of collaboration with the culinary team; the chefs were remarkably nice and accommodating. We were especially impressed with their flexibility, as Flags not only provides awesome food, including halal options, but also allows guests to bring meat from outside to be incorporated into the dishes, which is a rare and fantastic offering. The resulting food was delicious and received rave reviews from all our guests.
Beyond the food and staff, the venue itself is superb. The decor was beautiful and set a wonderful, elegant atmosphere for the engagement. Logistically, the venue is excellent, with great amenities like ample parking, making it easy for all our guests to attend.
Flags Banquet truly delivers an outstanding service, combining professional event management with top-tier culinary flexibility. We highly recommend them for any significant event or celebration!

featured_reviews.name: Shalu S Balan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Spanish Villa is a hidden gem in Jogeshwari—almost invisible from the outside, but once you step in, it truly feels magical. It’s a budget-friendly banquet hall that works beautifully for weddings and other functions. The team is very flexible and quick to make arrangements according to your timings and requirements.

They have two main halls. One of them features a Rajwada-style set which, in daylight, may look like an old heritage structure, but once the lights are on, it transforms into something absolutely stunning. The ambience becomes incredibly beautiful, and the photos and videos turn out highly cinematic—it genuinely adds a special charm to your memories.

The cost ranges approximately between ₹30,000 to ₹45,000 per hall, depending on your needs. Food arrangements need to be managed separately, as they do not have in-house catering, but overall, it’s an excellent value-for-money venue with a unique vibe.

featured_reviews.name: Adrian Rodrigues
featured_reviews.review_text:
A really nice AC banquet to come and have your family functions and events. It can be a little difficult to spot from the main road per if you follow Google Maps direction it will lead you to the right entrance. The pathway leading to the banquet is not great because it is inside some kind of an industrial complex. Other than that the banquet hall is really well maintained well it has clean washrooms and ample space for about 200 people. They have an outdoor area where they serve your lunch or dinner buffet. The service and the staff is really friendly and helpful. The food also was really good which was served by Amit caterers.
If you are coming by your own private vehicle they also have valet parking service.

featured_reviews.name: Glynis Ghag
featured_reviews.review_text: We had our Son's marriage at Universe Banquet,we were very happy with all the arrangments..all our guest were very happy with the quality of food and the ambience.We were well looked after by Mr Roshan Singh and team.. would highly recommend Universe Banquet to all.Keep up the excellent service.Thank You.

featured_reviews.name: Sylvia Dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text:
We were looking out for a place for our Silver Anniversary. And thanks to Google for guiding us towards Universe Banquet. It was love at first sight. We just loved the hall and ofcourse Vishals hospitality.

Vishal is a very patient and always ready to help guy. He helped us in all the way possible. Our guests loved the hall, the decor, and everything about the hall. The icing on the cake was the food. Each and every guest loved the starters, buffet, live counter and desert.

Thank you Vishal for everything. God bless you.

featured_reviews.name: maryluiza rozario
featured_reviews.review_text: We recently celebrated our wedding at Universe Banquets on 28th Dec 2025, and it was a dream come true! 🌟 The team went above and beyond - from the stunning setup to the mouth-watering food by Chris caterers. A huge shoutout to Banquet Manager Nilesh (Niel) for being super attentive and ensuring everything ran smoothly. Guests raved about the experience, and we're so grateful! Highly recommend Universe Banquets for your special day 😊"

featured_reviews.name: Lavina Rodrigues
featured_reviews.review_text: We booked Universe Banquet for my Neice’s wedding on 6th Dec 2025. Service was flawless; the staff were attentive, friendly, and always one step ahead. Food presentation was a feast for the eyes. It was catered by Amit Caterers and superbly managed by Vishal Shetty of Amit Caterers. Everything at the venue was arranged very well from the stage decor to the table and chair set up. Roshan was on his toes for any last minute arrangements that were requested by us. The hall is very clean and beautiful inside with elegant lighting and a lovely selfie point. The washrooms and changing rooms were also very clean. There was no room left for any complaints. Would highly recommend this venue for any celebrations.

featured_reviews.name: anthonydmelloj
featured_reviews.review_text:
Was here last month for my cousin's birthday party. Very good venue but finding parking is a bit difficult; they have valet parking.

Good food (local caterer) and live band (Band 24), all in all an evening well spent with family & friends.
